messages:
maya: draft ready — "Vaulted Deploys — Quickstrike Brief" 1-pager is in the drive. TL;DR: decision matrix for Hosted / Dedicated / Private, security guardrails, SLA expectations, and inbound routing play for sales/webinar leads. Link: https://drive.redwood/vaulted-quickstrike :page_facing_up:

ravi: nice. can you drop the 1-paragraph exec summary here? need it for the webinar landing page.

maya: exec para pasted below:
"For regulated teams evaluating LLM deployment options, 'Vaulted Deploys' summarizes trade-offs between Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments — focusing on data residency, KMS integration, and SLA-backed latency guarantees. It includes quick routing instructions for field sales and a suggested webinar outline highlighting security, cost predictability, and failover policies."

tom: love it. suggestion: add a small section 'when to pick Private' with 3 bullet points (gov/reg, high-entropy PII, air-gapped). keeps sales convs faster.

jess: on routing — recommend tags: `lead:regulation`, `priority:engaged`, `tech:security` then route to field-sales queue. also add 'request demo: dedicated trial' CTA.

maya: will add. webinar tie-in: 30-min tech+customer case study, CTA to book a security briefing. timeframe: 2 weeks out. @ravi can you confirm speaker availability?

ravi: confirms @maya. engineering can send an SME (amy from SRE) and a customer (finserv pilot) — amy ok with the date.

sre-amy: happy to join. i'll prepare a micro-case with latency numbers and fallbacks. also can share an anonymized architecture sketch.

jess: for the slide with SLAs, let's include sample SLO table: `99.9% uptime`, `p95 latency < 150ms hosted`, `p95 latency < 80ms dedicated` — mark as sample and subject to contract.

ops-bot: automated note — created task #4521: 'Finalize Vaulted Deploys 1-pager & webinar landing' assigned to maya, due in 5 business days.

tom: marketing checklist: 1) one-pager PDF 2) webinar landing copy 3) routing rules in SFDC 4) sales enablement email 5) leaderboard badge for field. i'll own #3 and #4.

maya: perfect. i'll push update to the doc by EOD with the new sections and the routing snippet. thanks everyone :rocket:

ravi: quick ask — should we include a short benchmark slide comparing token cost delta for caching+batching? customers ask this.

maya: yes. amy and eng-ml please provide sample delta numbers (hosted vs dedicated with KV cache). amy: can you share by tomorrow?

sre-amy: yes, will share two sample scenarios in the doc: chat baseline + high-throughput embedding job.

jess: once final, i'll create SFDC lead flows: rule = if `lead:regulation` AND ARR > 250k route to AE+solutions-eng; else route to SDR with security theme.

maya: filing final note: packaging will include onepager PDF, 1-slide benchmark, 1 webinar script, SFDC routing snippet, and email templates. uploading to /Marketing/Assets/vaulted-deploys.

ravi: thanks — next sync Thurs 10am to review slides.

maya: added calendar invite. end.
